task.title: M1: Repo identity and snapshot cache
task.description:
Implement repo identity and the on-disk snapshot cache. The repo-id is the SHA of the repository's root commit, taken from git rev-list --max-parents=0 HEAD (the first line when several roots exist), so it works with no remote and survives forks and renames; the origin URL is recorded in the snapshot for display only. Snapshots are stored at ~/.cache/codeviz/<repo-id>/<sha>.json.gz and the cache key is SHA plus toolVersion, so an analyzer upgrade invalidates earlier entries. Nothing is ever written inside the analyzed repository.

Acceptance criteria:
- repoId(root) returns the root-commit SHA and is stable across clones of the same history; a repo with multiple roots picks the first deterministically.
- cache.read(repoId, sha) returns the snapshot only when its toolVersion matches the running tool; otherwise it reports a miss.
- cache.write stores gzip JSON at ~/.cache/codeviz/<repo-id>/<sha>.json.gz, creating directories as needed, and honors XDG_CACHE_HOME when set.
- cache.list(repoId) enumerates cached SHAs with their analyzedAt and toolVersion.
- Tests use a temporary HOME/XDG dir and a throwaway git repo; none touch the real cache.
